nuggets.text: The Panthers play in Pitbull Stadium, the first college athletics building named after a musician.
Pitbull's stadium naming deal with the Panthers includes creating an anthem for FIU.
Panthers quarterback JJ Kohl stands 6-foot-7 and weighs 250 pounds.
JJ Kohl started his college career at Iowa State, where his father, Jamie, was the starting kicker from 1995 to 1998.
JJ Kohl threw for 301 yards in the Panthers' opener at South Florida.
This is FIU's 25th season of football, and Saturday's home opener is billed as the 25th Season Celebration.
Willie Simmons graduated from Clemson in three years, the fastest any football player there has done it.
Willie Simmons led Florida A&M to two HBCU national championships, in 2019 and 2023, before coming to FIU.
In 2025, Willie Simmons' first Panthers team reached a bowl and beat rival FAU for the first time since 2016.
Saturday marks the first time the Panthers and Buffalo have ever met on a football field.
